notes: Wave 1: Gloop now has trust (it remembers how you treat it, greets friends and spits jelly back at bullies), hunger, boredom and naps, mood colors, a glow at high trust and a bandage after 10 knockouts. New props: trampoline, fan and goo. New potion tool: shrink, grow, bouncy and liquid. New game: Target Toss. Daily gift with streaks, a Settings panel with volume, calm mode and reset, and 6 new trophies.
